tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen. Never put cards on bg without a border.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, list rows, inputs. The default reading ground.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: table/list section headers, segmented-control track, expanded row detail.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Meter tracks, avatar/initial discs, skeleton highlights, pressed state of surface-2.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards (decorative, not a control boundary).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines that must be seen: inputs, secondary buttons, unselected chips. 3:1 on surface and bg.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-2, surface-3.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata on bg/surface/surface-2/surface-3 (≥5.4:1 everywhere). Replaces the old #728078, which failed 4.5:1.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled labels only — never information a user needs (below 4.5:1 by design).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Brand green: gains, xP values, positive deltas, links/text buttons. Text on surface, bg and positive-soft.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background for positive pills, gain callouts, the leading row of a table.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses, rule errors, injury/doubt flags. Text on surface and negative-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Background for negative/invalid pills and error callouts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Baseline/estimate notices, 'doubtful' availability, amber data-health. Text on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warning pills and notices.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: NINETY+ lime. The '+' in the wordmark, selected-tab indicator, live dots, captain armband, highlights on ink. Fill only — never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (14:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Inverted feature surface: signal banner, hero cards, selected chips, desktop rail. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ink.

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink (≥7:1).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Ink in light theme, lime in dark so the main action is always the highest-contrast thing on screen.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on the primary button.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element; ≥5:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: Pitch background in squad views.

tokens.name: pitch-stripe
tokens.usage: Alternate mow stripe on the pitch.

tokens.name: pitch-line
tokens.usage: Pitch markings (decorative).

tokens.name: shirt
tokens.usage: Default outfield shirt fill on the pitch (DEF).

tokens.name: shirt-gk
tokens.usage: Goalkeeper shirt fill.

tokens.name: shirt-mid
tokens.usage: Midfielder shirt fill.

tokens.name: shirt-fwd
tokens.usage: Forward shirt fill.

tokens.name: on-shirt
tokens.usage: Shirt numbers/initials on every shirt fill.

tokens.name: fdr-1
tokens.usage: Fixture difficulty 1 (easiest). Always shows the number and the opponent.

tokens.name: on-fdr-1
tokens.usage: Text on fdr-1.

tokens.name: fdr-2
tokens.usage: Fixture difficulty 2.

tokens.name: on-fdr-2
tokens.usage: Text on fdr-2.

tokens.name: fdr-3
tokens.usage: Fixture difficulty 3 (neutral).

tokens.name: on-fdr-3
tokens.usage: Text on fdr-3.

tokens.name: fdr-4
tokens.usage: Fixture difficulty 4.

tokens.name: on-fdr-4
tokens.usage: Text on fdr-4.

tokens.name: fdr-5
tokens.usage: Fixture difficulty 5 (hardest).

tokens.name: on-fdr-5
tokens.usage: Text on fdr-5.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: header-glass
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar and tab bar background, used with backdrop blur.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen hero numbers and the one big headline per screen (e.g. projected points). 48px at ≥900px.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen titles in the top bar on compact; section heroes.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Player names in rows, list-section titles, button labels at md.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Saka's xP rises on an easy home run.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Row metadata (club · position · price), helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control labels, tab labels, chip text, segmented options.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The smallest text in the system. Timestamps, footnotes, axis labels. Never smaller.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Every text input and select — 16px stops iOS zooming on focus.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above titles and metric names (GW 9 · DEADLINE SAT 11:00).

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Prices, ownership, probabilities in rows. Tabular.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: The one key number per list row (xP). Tabular.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, pill inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between stacked row lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, gap between cards in a grid on compact.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on compact, card padding on compact.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding at ≥600px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter at ≥900px, gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major page regions on expanded.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top/bottom breathing room for empty states.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Fixture chips, shirt-label plates, small pills.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented control, list rows when inset.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero cards, the pitch frame.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, avatars, live dots, tab indicator.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards on bg.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Pressed/raised cards on desktop hover, floating action bar.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the tab bar edge.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable. Visual size can be smaller; the hit area cannot.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, segmented control on touch.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons inside cards on ≥900px only (pointer: fine).

tokens.name: top-bar
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar height on compact (64px at ≥900px).

tokens.name: tab-bar
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height, plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom).

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum PlayerRow height — fits a 40px avatar, two lines and the xP figure.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Desktop navigation rail width at ≥900px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width on expanded screens.

tokens.name: sheet-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a bottom sheet; centred as a dialog at ≥900px.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: ≥600: two-column card grids, 20px card padding. Still bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: ≥900: navigation moves to the side rail, sheets become side panels/dialogs, PlayerRow lists may become tables.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: ≥1200: three-column dashboards, content centres at content-max.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky list-section headers.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Top bar.

tokens.name: z-tabbar
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar and floating action bar.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts above everything.
